settings.heading: Why one at a time produces the pattern you know

settings.content: Almost every treatment addresses one point, and does it well. A barrier cream does barrier work. A laser does vessel work. A prescription calms inflammation.
Each leaves the other four exactly where it found them.
Read enough accounts and the same lines repeat:

settings.lines:
“It worked, then it just stopped.”
“What helps one week does nothing the next.”
“I’ve spent thousands — lasers, derm visits, monthly meds.”

settings.content: Read as personal failures, that history is crushing. Read as a loop, it’s just arithmetic.
“It works, then it stops working” sounds like bad luck. In a five-point loop, it’s the expected result.
